`final class ShaderTranslation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderTranslation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderTranslation.java)

The translated sources of a shader, ready for the graphics API, the vertex and fragment stages and the optional stencil write stage.

## Description

[`GlslShaderTranslator.translate`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/#GlslShaderTranslator-method-translate) returns it, and the constructor of [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) hands it to the `compileProgram` hook of the backend.

## Learn more

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#from-source-to-program)

### getDialect

<a id="ShaderTranslation-method-getStencilFragment"></a>

### getStencilFragment

`String getStencilFragment()` 

Returns the fragment stage of the stencil write pass, which outputs the updated stencil value; `null` without stencil emulation.
